summary: SPX +1.66% / NDX +3.36% in a narrow mega-cap-led relief rally: MSFT +15.5% earnings blowout plus a violent semiconductor rebound (SOXX +8.5%, MU +18.4%, LRCX +18.0%) drove the tape while VIX collapsed -17.2%. Breadth stayed negative (SPX 197/301) and the regime is still Down/Neutral-Bear — a bounce inside a correction, not a trend change. META -7.95% on earnings. Hard-asset rotation into gold/silver/miners/uranium/renewables broadened underneath.
